answer: Require each new identity to earn a crystal-clear reputation trail before it can vote or claim rewards: it must wander through a sequence of unrelated, independently verified tasks over several epochs, with each step timestamped and countersigned by a different peer. A Sybil operator cannot shortcut this tide of slow work - cloning an identity means redoing the whole itinerary, paying the same time and attestation cost again, while any cluster reusing the same task history is exposed by overlapping trails and loses its deposits.
